content_sections.title: Hear two different words
content_sections.body_text: Listen for one sound difference in pairs such as ship/sheep. Repeat slowly, then use each word in a short personal sentence.

content_sections.title: Ask and answer
content_sections.body_text: A: Is this your name? B: Yes, it is. Notice the vowel sounds before you answer.
